metadata.title: Show 0262: Ritmi di Milano by Painè Cuadrelli (Radio Papesse)
metadata.description: This is radio show # 262 of season 22 of the Radia weekly comissioned radio art programs. It was submited by Radio Papesse. It was broadcasted in all Radia stations in the week between 05.04.2010 and 11.04.2010. Read about Radia on wikipedia. -- Ritmi di Milano - a sound portrait of Milan produced by Painè Cuadrelli - marks our official first entry as RADIA member. It is a pleasure to launch the series with Painè Cuadrelli and his soundwalk in Milan, the city Luciano Berio and Bruno Maderna portraied in 1954 in 'Portrait of a city', the first electronic music piece ever recorded at the Milan's RAI Fonology Studios (Italian Radio and Television). As the oral narration is a primary key of this soundwork, Cuadrelli's portrait is much more about sounds and field recording; it was produced recording sounds in the city of Milano, Italy and manipulating it into a collage of small compositions and rhythms. The show is intended as a modified soundwalk, where pieces of real-world soundscape get transformed, cut'n'pasted, mixed and remixed, becoming something else, yet keeping the original texture. Recordings were made in main spots of the city centre: Piazza del Duomo, Duomo (inside), Triennale Museum, Teatro dell'Arte, Parco Sempione, to name a few, in differents moments of the day and night. No addictional sounds were used. >>CREDITS<< produced, composed and mixed by PainÃ¨ Cuadrelli assistant: Mattia Trabucchi recordings made with; Edirol R-09, Apple iPhone with Audiofile Engineering Fire Application, Tascam DR 100 sound editing made with: Audiofile Engineering Wave Editor, Bias Peak post-production and mix made with: Ableton Live, Apple Logic Studio
